breakdown.description: The chemical system is restricted to Ga-N, but the referenced stable-entry set is Mg-Ga-N.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly asked for a phase diagram of the 'Ga-N' system while providing stable entries for 'Mg-Ga-N'. The ground truth corrects this by instructing to build the diagram from the provided entries (implying the Mg-Ga-N system). The agent's specification repeated the original error, stating it will 'generate a PhaseDiagram object for the Ga-N chemical system using the stable entries', which is contradictory and incorrect.
